text_block_list.text: The annual summer camp has begun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув tells Нарита Брайан that Biwa
Hayahide
will be joining the camp later
than everyone else.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув lets it slip that Hayahide's
been held
back by a comprehensive
physical but doesn't go
into more detail,
leaving Нарита Брайан uneasy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
